source_refs.applicability: Chrome on a computer; current open page
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To the right of the address bar, select Bookmark this page.

source_refs.model_visible_text: To save a page for later in desktop Chrome, go to that page and select Bookmark this page to the right of the address bar. This action saves the page currently open.

source_refs.title: Change mouse settings
source_refs.section: Windows 11 > Change how the mouse pointer looks
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Change the size of the pointer by using the slide next to Size.
source_refs.extraction_method: Official help page read through web tool; model-visible note is a close paraphrase.
source_refs.model_visible_text: Open Start > Settings > Accessibility > Mouse pointer and touch. Under Mouse pointer, use the Size slider to change pointer size. Mouse pointer style is a separate setting for how the pointer looks.
